SELECT e.face FROM tempemoji t INNER JOIN emoji e ON t.emoji_name = e.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE
(t.mint IS NOT NULL AND t.maxt IS NOT NULL AND #{temp} >= t.mint AND #{temp} < t.maxt) OR (t.mint IS NULL AND t.maxt IS NOT NULL AND #{temp} < t.maxt) OR (t.maxt IS NULL AND t.mint IS NOT NULL AND #{temp} > t.mint)
LIMIT 1
